Datasets MUST be loaded via OmniRec's RecSysDataSet.use_dataloader() using DataSet.MovieLens100K, DataSet.Amazon2014VideoGames, and DataSet.HetrecLastFM.

Preprocessing MUST use OmniRec's Pipe chaining with these operations: (1) MakeImplicit(threshold=3) for MovieLens100K and Amazon2014VideoGames to convert ratings > 3 to implicit (HetrecLastFM is already implicit and must not be converted), (2) CorePruning(core=5) for 5-core filtering on all three datasets, (3) UserHoldout for train/test splitting.
For each dataset, 5 independent UserHoldout splits MUST be created by calling set_random_state() with 5 different seeds before each split, producing 5 versions of each preprocessed dataset.

Three algorithms MUST be configured via OmniRec's ExperimentPlan: LensKit.ImplicitMFScorer (ALS), LensKit.ItemKNNScorer, and LensKit.PopScorer — all with feedback='implicit' and default hyperparameters.
Evaluation MUST use OmniRec's Evaluator with Precision(k=[1,5,10]) and NDCG(k=[1,5,10]) ranking metrics.
The experiment MUST test all combinations: 3 datasets × 3 algorithms × 5 random seeds = 45 runs, running each preprocessed dataset through all algorithm+metric combinations via run_omnirec().
Results MUST be collected and aggregated per (dataset, algorithm, seed) to enable a statistical analysis comparing how random seed variation affects accuracy across algorithms and datasets.
